director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions mein equal shares dekhenge—jaise cricket team mein runs baantna. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Socho ek paratha do players mein barabar baantna ho—har player ko kitna milega? Golu ko baad mein tum sikhaogi.
Riya, ek roti ko do bilkul barabar tukdon mein kaato. Har tukda poori roti ka half hai. Do tukde barabar hain?
Theek hai, Riya—aur dheere chalenge. Ek shape ko barabar parts mein baantte hain. Do equal parts ko halves kehte hain. Do parts barabar hain?
Riya, ek poori roti ko do barabar hisson mein baanto. Har hissa poori roti ka aadha hota hai. Kya dono hisse barabar honge?
Nahi, Riya. Do barabar hisson mein har hissa aadha hota hai. Agar paanch barabar hisse hon, har hissa kya kehlaayega?
Riya, teen barabar hisson mein har hissa ek-tihai hota hai. Ab 1/3 mein neeche ka 3 kya batata hai?
Riya, kalpana karo ek roti ke teen barabar tukde hain; unmein ek tukda liya. Kitne tukde liye?
Riya, fraction mein upar ka number liye gaye hisson ki ginti batata hai. 1/3 mein upar 1 kyun hai?
Riya, 1/3 mein upar wala 1 liya gaya hissa dikhata hai. Ab neeche wala number dekhenge. Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
